name: GA Cubers Warm Up 2024
information: This competition has odd events and not the normal 3x3x3 Speedsolving event. We recommend Parking at the Student Center Parking located at 353 Ferst Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30332. The Georgia location for CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship will happen in the same room 1 hour after this competition ends. If you are interested you will need to register for that competition as well as this one to participate in both.
